meta._note: Hand-written sample showing the shape of a recording and the F09 failure story. Not real agent output. Record a real run with: python evals/run_evals.py --live --judge

verdict.reason: Connection refused to staging and 41 other tests failed in the same run with no recent changes, so the environment was down.
verdict.next_step: Check staging health and re-run once it is reachable.

judge.critique: Cites the same-run failure count and the absence of changes.

verdict.reason: Playwright was bumped to 1.64.0 by dependabot but the runner still has the old browser build, so launch fails before any test runs.
verdict.next_step: Add 'npx playwright install' to the CI image after dependency updates.

judge.critique: Names the dependabot change and the missing browser.

verdict.reason: Navigation timed out and 44 tests failed in the same run with no app changes.
verdict.next_step: Check staging load and network from the CI runner.

judge.critique: Correct, but doesn't separate timeout from refusal.

verdict.reason: An approved SSO button now also matches the 'Sign in' locator, causing a strict mode violation.
verdict.next_step: Use getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign in', exact: true }).

judge.critique: Ties the failure to the approved change and gives an exact fix.

verdict.reason: It fails intermittently (4/10) and relies on a 300ms hard wait before a non-retrying check.
verdict.next_step: Remove waitForTimeout and rely on the retrying toHaveText assertion.

judge.critique: Uses both the flaky history and the hard wait.

verdict.reason: The test looks for a 'Login' button that was renamed to 'Sign in' in an approved change.

judge.critique: Correct; could mention the change was approved UX copy.

verdict.reason: The error now reveals the email and which field was wrong, which breaks the generic-error requirement; the change had no ticket.
verdict.next_step: Raise a bug against commit e2f88b1 referencing AC4.

judge.critique: Links the behaviour to the requirement and the unticketed commit.

verdict.reason: After the attempt-counter refactor the Sign in button stays enabled after 3 failures, so lockout no longer works.
verdict.next_step: Raise a bug against commit f01a7c3.

judge.critique: Cites the refactor and the broken lockout behaviour.

verdict.reason: The click timed out after 30 seconds, which suggests the environment was slow or unresponsive.
verdict.next_step: Re-run the test and check staging performance.

verdict.reason: Fails only intermittently since parallel runs were enabled, with other workers sharing the same account.
verdict.next_step: Give each worker its own test account.

judge.critique: Right call, but generic about why sharing the account triggers lockout.
